payload.comment: Preprocessing stage is consistent and complete. All deterministic checks pass (deterministic_findings is empty). Key verifications: (1) Split sizes (train 89996, val 10004, test 7180) match the official MedMNIST PathMNIST distribution exactly; subsampled=false confirms no truncation. (2) n_channels=3, n_classes=9, image_shape_hwc=[28,28,3] are correct for the standard 28×28 RGB MedMNIST PathMNIST task. (3) Provenance is well-documented: archive_md5, per-split selected_index_sha256, code_sha256, package versions, and platform are all present. (4) Class distributions between train and val are nearly identical (max proportion difference < 0.001), confirming no split-level distribution mismatch. Imbalance ratio of 1.63 is modest. (5) The representation plan is sound: 'standardize' normalization using train-only statistics (train_stats_only=true) is the correct anti-leakage practice; channel means (~0.53–0.74) and stds (~0.12–0.18) confirm the data is in [0,1] range and benefits from zero-centering and variance equalization. (6) Augmentation (hflip, vflip, brightness; factor 4) yields augmented_train_size=359984=89996×4, which is arithmetically consistent. (7) duplicate_train_samples=0 and blank_image_fraction=0.0 confirm data integrity. (8) The test set originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K), which is a legitimate domain-shift evaluation design, not an error. Minor non-blocking warnings: (a) llm_model_digest is null, so the exact qwen3.8 checkpoint is not pinned, weakening full reproducibility of LLM-assisted decisions; (b) test-set class distribution was intentionally not profiled (anti-leakage), leaving test_imbalance_ratio=1.0 and test_to_train_prevalence_ratio=[] as placeholders. Neither issue blocks progression. No deterministic findings justify revision or stop. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null; the exact qwen3.8 model checkpoint is not pinned, weakening reproducibility for LLM-assisted downstream steps (non-blocking).

Test-set class distribution was not profiled (samples_profiled=100000 covers train+val only); test_imbalance_ratio=1.0 and test_to_train_prevalence_ratio=[] are placeholders, not computed values. This is a reasonable anti-leakage design choice but limits cross-split distribution verification.

Brightness augmentation on H&E histology patches may alter staining appearance in ways that do not correspond to real biological variation; consider verifying that the brightness range is conservative (non-blocking design note).
